Station Reference No.258/37.

COPY OF POLICE REPORT DATED
SEPTEMBER II, 1937.
--------------------------------

BRITISH SUBJECT ARRESTED BY CHINESE AUTHORITIES.

At 6.10 p.m. 10-9-37 D.S. Yankovsky, French Police,
reported to B'well Station that whilst Inspector Chiang
Foh Dien ( 蔣 福 田 ), French Police, was making enquiries
at the 3rd. Section, Nantao Headquarters, S.C.G.P.Bureau,
on the afternoon of 10-9-37 he saw a male foreigner de-
tained there.

This foreigner gave him a small chit on which was
written " I am Mr. J. Allen - When shall I return - 9/9/37"

On the evening of 10-9-37 Mr. G. Manley of the Im-
perial Chemical Industries Ltd. called at Central Station
with British passport No.7234 in the name of Mr. John
Allen and stated that this person was missing.

Mr. Manley was referred to B'Well Station,efforts
made to get in touch with Nantao Headquarters on the
10-9-37 met with no results.

At 9 a.m. 11-9-37 D.I. Toon communicated with Nantao
Headquarters and ascertained that Mr. Allen was detained
there, having been arrested by a member of the S.C.G.P.B.
at about 10 a.m. 9-9-37 in the vicinity of Poh Sing Kyung
( 北 新 涇 ), no further details available.

D.I. Toon and D.S.I. Wu Chen Mo proceeded to the
French Police and obtained the chit written by Mr. Allen
and with the assistance of Inspector Chiang Foh Dien,
French Police, proceeded to Nantao Headquarters where upon
producing Mr. Allen's British Passport he was handed over
against receipt.

1937年9月11日警察报告副本。
---

英国侨民被中国当局逮捕。

1937年9月10日下午6时10分，法国巡捕房警司 Yankovsky 向静安寺路警局报告称，1937年9月10日下午，法国巡捕房巡官蒋福田（Chiang Foh Dien）在上海市政府警察局南市总部第三科进行查询时，看到一名外籍男子被拘留在那里。

这名外国人递给他一张小纸条，上面写着：“我是 J. Allen 先生——我何时回来——1937年9月9日”

1937年9月10日晚，帝国化学工业有限公司（Imperial Chemical Industries Ltd.）的 G. Manley 先生持名为 John Allen 先生的英国护照（第7234号）前往中央警局，称此人失踪。

Manley 先生被指引至静安寺路警局，1937年9月10日为与南市总部取得联系所作的努力未获结果。

1937年9月11日上午9时，督察 Toon 与南市总部联系，获悉 Allen 先生被拘留在那里，他是由上海市政府警察局的一名成员于1937年9月9日上午10时左右在北新泾（Poh Sing Kyung）附近逮捕的，无更多细节可供提供。

督察 Toon 和副督察吴振模（Wu Chen Mo）前往法国巡捕房，取得了 Allen 先生所写的纸条，并在法国巡捕房巡官蒋福田的协助下，前往南市总部，在出示 Allen 先生的英国护照后，对方出具收据将其移交。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

The Nantao Authorities request that an official
letter from Police Headquarters be sent to them acknow-
ledging receipt of Mr. Allen.

As Mr. Allen is both deaf and dumb several written
questions were put to him with a view to ascertaining
under what circumstances he was arrested, but no tangible
answer could be obtained.

Mr. Manley, who is Mr. Allen's brother-in-law was
communicated with and attended B'well Station, he stated
that Mr. Allen was a mental case and could not give a
clear answer to any questions as he became confused.

Mr. Allen was handed over to the care of Mr. Manley
who stated he would see that he returned to his home at
103 Burkill Road.

Certified true copy:

*Wmace Dermott.*

P.A. & O.C. (E...)
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

南市当局要求警察总局向他们发送一封正式信函，确认收到 Allen 先生。

由于 Allen 先生既聋又哑，为了查明他被捕的情况，向他提出了几个书面问题，但未能得到任何实质性的回答。

已与 Allen 先生的姐夫 Manley 先生取得联系，他来到静安寺路警局，称 Allen 先生患有精神疾病，因神志混乱无法对任何问题给出清晰回答。

Allen 先生被移交给 Manley 先生照管，Manley 先生表示将确保其返回位于伯基尔路103号（103 Burkill Road）的住所。

核证无误副本：

*Wmace Dermott.*

助理局长兼主管（E...）
